title: Sign in
subtitle: Sign in to Bifrost
welcomeSubtitle: Sign in to your account to continue

consent.missingFlowBody: This URL is missing the <code0>flow</code0> query parameter. Restart the connection from your MCP client.
consent.linkUnavailableBody: This authorization link may have expired or already been used. Restart the connection from your MCP client to get a fresh link.
consent.chooseIdentity: Choose how you'd like to identify yourself to Bifrost
consent.restartFromMcp: Restart the connection from your MCP client.
consent.useVirtualKey: Use a Virtual Key from your Bifrost workspace
consent.keyLinkedHint: If this key is linked to a user account, you'll be asked to sign in to confirm your identity.
consent.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
consent.invalidBody: The authorization link has expired, been used already, or had its token stripped. Restart the connection from your MCP client to get a fresh link.
consent.recognizeApplication: Continue only if you recognize this application and its callback destination:
consent.localhostWarning: This application only returns to your own computer, so its name cannot be verified. Any app running locally could use it.
consent.signInRedirectBody: This authorization needs a signed-in Bifrost account. Taking you to sign in, you'll come straight back here.

setup.instructionsIntro: The setup token is a secret the operator sets on the server. Set it one of two ways, then restart Bifrost:
setup.instructionsConfig: Add setup_token at the top level of config.json. It accepts a literal value, an env.VAR reference, or a vault.path reference:
setup.instructionsHeader: API clients send the same value in the {{header}} header. The token stops working once dashboard authentication is enabled.
setup.unreachable: Could not reach Bifrost. Check that the server is running.
setup.checkFailed: Bifrost returned {{status}} while checking the token
setup.title: Finish setting up Bifrost
setup.description: Dashboard authentication is not configured, so the API is locked. Enter the setup token to continue and create an admin account.
setup.whereToFind: Where do I find the setup token?
setup.notConfigured: No setup token is configured on this server, so setup cannot continue yet.
